description: Get one scheduled post's full detail by slot ID: status, title, scheduled time, generation progress, its schedule (providers, publish mode) and persona. userNotices (requiresUser true) and providerFailures are on the slot as soon as an account fails, including while the slot is still publishing. Relay each userNotices notice. Only the user can fix that account. Do not retry it. Use the slotId from list_posts.
